notes.title: UPDATE #29: Fly High To The Sky! 🐉✨
notes.notes:
Good Day, Tips Fedora
Our goal for Ragna, Tru, and their Mech is to make them as exciting to use for exploring the world of Driftland as our small team can manage. This time, Ragna received the upgrades!

Instead of endlessly holding Shift to sprint, tapping it now makes Ragna flap her wings with powerful force, launching her forward in a temporary speed boost. Time it right and you can pull off two quick boosts – BUT with Dragon Boost Plus, you can chain three in a row!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/3107223bd94d6a6d62c1c6100e63ce96095b161a.gif

Additionally, Ragna can gain a boost by diving. The longer she dives, the longer the speed boost lasts. Combine this with a regular boost to create long, high-speed bursts!

We hope these changes will enhance Ragna’s scouting abilities and make traveling more fun and cool! ːsteamhappyː

We've also added some long-awaited user experience updates! And there will be plenty more of those coming soon!

notes.title: UPDATE #28: Pet the Steam Deck
notes.notes:
HIA!



In this update, we are giving you the option to tame Ferins (and other animals in future updates). Tamed animals, when given shelter, will produce useful items. But first, you need to figure out how to do that :)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/e937486146fb348d98c545ba3869cd165b3276c7.gif"]

We’ve also made big improvements for Steam Deck users. First Dwarf already has the “Playable” status, but we’re pushing further to get the “Verified”✅ badge. Now, when you launch the game on Steam Deck, everything should configure itself automatically. Savegame naming will bring up the on-screen keyboard right away, and text size should be better adjusted to the smaller screen. Enjoy a smoother and more comfortable experience!


If you're having trouble figuring out how to unlock the hidden tech needed for taming Ferins, here's a guide:
Spoilers Ahead!
[spoiler]To unlock Ferin Treats, you first need to heal a slightly tainted Ferin using the Taint Cleansing Bolt. Then, go to the Technology menu, and Ferin Treats should now be unlocked. To tame a Ferin, place the treats near it, but be careful not to scare it. If you are within its sight while it eats the treats, it will become tamed and no longer run away from you. Once tamed, you can lead the Ferin to the new structure called the Ferin Shelter. When everything needed is provided, the shelter will start producing Ferin Teeth.[/spoiler][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/87f8ee2ef8189a716a8245794041b18cdd03cdef.gif"]

New Hidden Technology system – there will be some technologies that you will need to figure out how to unlock by finding something in the world, talking with an NPC, or doing something. More of this kind of tech will come in the next updates :)

notes.title: Update #27:🦊Paws & Battlements 🧱
notes.notes:
Good Day!
With every update, the game keeps getting better and better, we hope you’ll enjoy the fixes and new additions! 😊



Many of you asked for stone walls, and we added them in the previous update, but why stop there? That’s why, in this update, we’re introducing a new special type of structure/wall called Battlements!
They’re much stronger than other walls (and more expensive too), BUT they also act as platforms, making it easier to defend your base using ranged weapons!
One more important thing, they add more visual variety for those (like me too) who like to tinker with the aesthetic side of settlements. 🙂



💡Battlements will get visual lifting in the next update.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/5135ae02d7cbc10abe95ece50b41d305858492fa.gif"]
[hr][/hr]


We’ve always wanted to improve the wildlife in our game, but major bugs and other features kept getting in the way. I’m happy to inform you that we’ve finally started making changes!
From now on, Ferins will roam the world, respond to the player, and search for food, water, shelter, and more. 😊

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/d9a75d8b264f0841e583f665d1fea16ea0294b3c.gif"]
[hr][/hr]


The world should also feel more alive thanks to new improvements in enemy AI.
Lone monsters will now wander the world, and if they choose to, they’ll taint the berry bushes.
This ties neatly into the Ferin AI: if a Ferin eats the tainted berries, it will get sick and eventually transform into a monster version, UNLESS you heal it with the new Taint Cleansing Bolts! Then, it will become friendly to you.



💡Ferins, and other animals, will continue to receive upgrades in the near future. 

💡Not all the monster have the ability for tainting the berries, Hunter Felfs can do that. This way this should be more balanced.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/d2000ea7213bf4a70c681d8818f0e74face0512e.gif"]
[hr][/hr]


We’ve also added the ability to refuel mana through the mana pipeline connections!
If you build a proper pipeline network across the island, there’ll be no need to search for mana springs anymore. 🙂



As for playable characters, we want to make traversing the islands easier, more enjoyable (and cooler).In this update, we’ve upgraded jumping for the Mech, you can now adjust jump height depending on how long you hold the jump button.
If you hold it long enough, you’ll charge it to the max. Only this max-charged jump will consume mana :)



💡Next in line are improvements to Ragna's flying, and after that, Tru will finally get a cool way to travel across the islands!



We’ve added shortcuts to every tab in the RPG menu!
Please keep in mind this is still a work in progress—exiting the game using the shortcut for the current tab will be coming in the next update!


💡 We’ll also be adding numeric shortcuts for structures soon.



Oh, and thanks to your feedback, we’ve added the ability for Tru to swim!
A popular misconception is that dwarves don’t swim. The truth is, they do! They just don’t enjoy it much… but their pride, resilience, and stamina keep them afloat. 😄  



Check out the full list of improvements and fixes below.👇

notes.title: 1st Anniversary Update (#25)
notes.notes:
🎉Wow, it’s already been a year!
Huge thanks to everyone who played, supported us, shared feedback, or just had fun in First Dwarf. 

This journey has been wild, unpredictable, and incredibly rewarding. Your ideas and reports have shaped the game in ways we never imagined. You’re not just the community. 
You’re part of the dev team!

🚀How Far We’ve Come
Over the past year, the game has grown massively. The world is now four times bigger. We’ve added new islands, weapons, technologies, character progression, and entire clans arriving with fresh challenges. You asked for more freedom in building, so we made it possible for the mech, Tru, and Ragna to all build. You asked for better UI, stamina balance, clearer notifications, easier wall and mana-pipe placement, and we delivered. We added a flying ship, full Steam Deck support, and cloud saves. That’s 25 updates so far, and honestly, we’re just getting started.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/0f920deba9162aa7e33e5fe3465db35a5ed481f8.gif"]

And for those who want to jump straight into testing new features, we’re also including a special savegame with everything unlocked in the technology tab and ready to play around with. This is just for those who want to experiment quickly and freely.

💖 Love, War & Fixes – Update #18!
Hey, Dwarven pioneers! There’s no better time to team up than now. Steam’s Couch Co-Op Event is here, bringing a co-op discount and the perfect excuse to grab a partner and dive into the world of First Dwarf. Whether you're building, fighting, or just making sure the other person doesn’t waste all your resources, Update #18 has a lot to offer.

🔥 Highlights

 New Stat Windows for Buildings, Items, and Weapons – highly requested details on costs and effects. No more guesswork!
 Better Attack Patterns for Enemy Waves – less predictable, more natural. Now they won't just pile on one pre-determined spot.
 Updated Quests – clearer objectives, polished dialogues and better guidance

⚙️ Additional Features & Fixes

 Acid damage no longer cancels your combo – keep swinging!
 Updated quest icons on the UI – check the top-left corner.
 Environmental polishing – added a new path from Archseeker to the lower segment of Canyon Island.
 HP, Mana, and Stamina bars cleaned up – clearer, neater, and easier to read.
 Fixed area-wide quest detection when settling an island – smoother quest progression.
 Tree chopping FX now appears in the right place, even for oddly shaped trees – realism at its finest.
 Wild Wave base scoring fixed – no more weird 1/0 Felf waves.
 Camera adjustments – fewer awkward angles when colliding with trees.
 Wild Wave egg flight time now scales with difficulty:
 Easy – 33% more time before enemy wave
 Hard – 33% less time before enemy wave Fixed visual glitches in forests – no more flickering foliage.

🔮 What’s Next?
We’re far from done. More mechanics and fresh content are on the way, but the biggest change is something that has been missing until now. Characters with real roles in the world.

Speaking of which…
💘 Meet Val and Lyra – A Valentine’s Surprise!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/13372cc43e5ad266e2dd509db3cbfca3cac5769a.png
So far, the colonists have been just that. People settling the islands and working in the background. But among them are key figures with their own stories, goals, and conflicts. With upcoming updates, these NPCs will become more than just settlers. You will get to know them, interact with them, and understand their motivations, relationships, and the challenges they face. The first two to step into the spotlight are Val and Lyra. But they won’t be the last.

First up, Val. An aspiring geomancer and healer, scheduled to arrive later with the Survivalist Guild. Due to her beliefs, instincts, and readiness to act, she built her own airship and flew after Tru as soon as she could. She cares deeply for her people, including her childhood friend Tru, with whom she shared many youthful adventures. She will be joining the game soon, though not necessarily in the next update, bringing new interactions, fresh dynamics, and her own unique perspective on the world.

Later, with the arrival of the 5th island, comes Lyra. She is a lone elven figure with a past as mysterious as the Taint she once fought. She carries her burdens in silence, but her story will be one worth uncovering.

So grab your co-op partner, double-check your defenses, and get ready for whatever Driftland throws your way. Just remember, sometimes the biggest battles aren’t fought with hammers and dragonfire, but with trust and partnership.

🚀 See you in Driftland!

notes.title: 🚀 Update #13: New Horizons, New Heights!
notes.notes:
Adventurers of Driftland,

Time to stretch those mechanical legs - Update #13 has landed! With it, we’re officially moving from version 0.5xx to 0.6xx. Why the shift? It’s all about the arrival of the shiny new 4th Island! 🏝️

This isn’t just "another island". It’s our first step into a bolder, more layered world. The 4th Island brings a fresh visual vibe, introduces a whole new vertical structure, and adds some fresh challenges to keep things interesting. It’s the beginning of something bigger, and yes, this island will continue to evolve in upcoming updates.

But that’s not all! We’ve been busy behind the scenes cooking up new features, taking inspiration straight from your feedback. Some of these ideas are already live in this update, while others are planned for future releases as part of the 0.6xx update series. And yes, work on the 5th Island is already in motion. So stay tuned - there’s plenty more to come.

Alright, enough talk. Let’s get into the good stuff. Here’s what’s fresh in Update #13:

Full Change Log Version 0.610

🌴 New Island: Welcome to the 4th Island!
Behold the biggest highlight of Update #13 - the arrival of the 4th Island! Here’s what makes it truly special:
🌄 Vertical design: Unlike any previous islands, this new island is built with layers and elevation, creating a new level of vertical exploration and strategic building. Get ready for a whole new way to approach construction and combat.
🎨 A fresh, visual refresh: This island brings a new aesthetic vibe to Driftland—new biomes, updated foliage, and more dynamic, natural structures make every moment here feel like an adventure.
🔓 New quests, new challenges, and more adventure: New objectives await, and with them, fresh gameplay twists and surprises.The 4th Island is only the beginning of what’s to come as we continue our journey in the 0.6.x era. Prepare for more content, features, and surprises in the updates to follow!

✨ What’s New?

 🔹 Crosshair for Precision Building
A small change with big impact—now there’s a crosshair in the center of the screen when building, making it far easier to place objects exactly where you want them. 🔹 Enemy Item Drops
Enemies now drop items after you unlock new technologies. You’ll want to hunt them down and see what treasures they’re hiding! 🔹 Favorite Recipes in Crafting Stations
Sick of scrolling? We’ve got you. You can now mark recipes as favorites in crafting stations, making your go-to blueprints faster to find and easier to manage. 🔹 Area Damage for Hammer Special Attacks
The hammer just got mightier. Now special attacks from hammer-type weapons deal area damage, so you can smash through multiple enemies in one powerful swing.
🔬 New Technology Tree Items
More tools, weapons, and consumables to expand your playstyle and strategy. Here’s what’s new in the Tech Tree:
🛡️ [Weapon] Dwarfen Mech Crossbow – Precision, power, and versatility packed into one ranged powerhouse.
💥 [Consumable] Standard Bolts – Essential ammo for the Dwarfen Mech Crossbow.
💥 [Consumable] Acid Bolts – Splash some extra damage on your enemies with these powerful, corrosive bolts.
🍷 [Consumable] Attack Up Potion – Boost your attack power and become an unstoppable force.
🛡️ [Consumable] Defense Up Potion – Take more hits and stay in the fight longer with this defensive brew.
🌱 New Plants
More flora, more fun. Here’s what’s sprouting up on Driftland:
🌿 Dragon Weed – A fiery-looking plant with some potent properties.
🍄 Mushroom Flowers – Strange hybrids that are as unusual as they are useful.
🧪 Acid Shroom – Handle with care. This one’s got a bite to it.
⚙️ New Crafting Materials
To create more, you’ll need to gather more. Here’s what’s new in the world of crafting resources:

🦷 Monster Tooth – The perfect trophy... and also a key material for crafting.
🧪 Acid – Corrosive, dangerous, and oh-so-useful for certain creations.
🐺 Fur – Soft, fuzzy, and essential for several crafting recipes.
💎 Plasma (rare) – A rare find with massive potential in crafting upgrades.
🦄 Monster Horn (rare) – Not every beast has one, but you’ll want to grab it when they do.
🕸️ Monster Spike (rare) – Sharp, deadly, and ready to be turned into something special.
🐛 Fixes
Here’s what we’ve cleaned up to make the world of Driftland more stable and fun:
🔧 Quest Visibility Bugs – Fixed issues where quests wouldn’t check off when finished, sometimes wouldn’t appear at all, or weren’t visible to co-op partners.
🔧 Attack from Above – Resolved an issue where attacks from above wouldn’t register as hits.
🔧 Anchor Spot Animation – Anchor Spots now display their proper building animation.
🧪 Experimental
🔹 Intuitive Wall and Mana-Pipe BuildingWe’re working on a brand-new system to make building walls and mana pipes faster, more straightforward, and more intuitive. As an early look at this system, you can now hold down the build button to continuously build wall segments one after another. This is an experimental feature, so let us know how it feels![previewyoutube=jQ5fWd81HKs;full][/previewyoutube]
The 4th Island is just the beginning of the journey into the 0.6.x era of First Dwarf. With every update, we’ll be introducing even more features, systems, and surprises leading up to the monumental arrival of the 5th Island. But for now, it’s time to explore the layered, vertical world of the 4th Island and see what’s waiting for you.

Your feedback is essential - so if you’ve got thoughts, ideas, or epic stories to share, we’re all ears on Steam and Discord!

Happy exploring,
The First Dwarf Team

notes.title: ✨Update #12 New Challenges, Big Changes!
notes.notes:
Adventurers of Driftland,

We’re thrilled to bring you Update #12, a pivotal step in First Dwarf’s journey! This update lays the groundwork for the highly anticipated 0.6x milestone, coming later this year, complete with a brand-new island and exciting features. But before we take that leap, we’ve focused on introducing fundamental changes to the game’s core mechanics to make your experience more satisfying than ever.

⚠️IMPORTANT NOTICE⚠️
We’ve made significant tweaks to the leveling system, the old boosts that were pretty overpowered. *For now* your current stats won’t change upon loading, the new system will activate after reaching new level, but previous levels will be calculated with old system. So we highly recommend to start a new game if you want to feel the new flow. 

🧙‍♂️ RECOMMENDATION: To fully experience the improved leveling mechanics, we suggest starting a new game! (But don’t worry, it’s not mandatory if you’re more excited to jump into the other features.)

💡 Your Feedback Is Magical: As always, your input helps us shape First Dwarf into the game you’ll love even more. Let us know what you think in the Steam Community forums!

Now that you’ve been properly warned and prepared, let’s dive into the details:

Full Change Log Version 0.568

New Features and Changes
🔹 Difficulty Levels
The long-awaited difficulty system is here! Choose the level of challenge that suits your playstyle. This is our first iteration, and we’re eager to hear your feedback—let us know if it improves your gameplay flow and satisfaction with progress.

🔹Crafting Menus Overhaul | part 1
The Crafting menus in Workshop, Alchemy Station, and Forge have been revamped and improved for better usability. Please have in mind that this will be expanded. Features like crafting queuing are already being developed. Keep your suggestions coming!

🔹 New Badass Tru
Tru has undergone a complete visual overhaul, bringing even more personality and heroism to your adventures.

🔹 Enhanced Visual Feedback
✨ Added new visual effects and indicators for corrupted spawners and meteor-triggered spawners.
✨ Enemies will now display 0, 1, or 2 skulls below their HP bars to indicate their difficulty tier.

🔹 Improved Co-op Experience
There is now a 125 metre (about 25 grid squares) safe radius around the player who hosted the game, which will prevent players who joined as a client from fading to black and respawning.

🔹 Grid Improvement
Enemy corpses will no longer block the building grid, making base building/rebuilding easier during times of pressure such as enemy waves.

🔹 Added 10% dmg resistance for each piece of Mech Battle Armor Set

Optimizations
🚀 Performance Boosts
Enjoy smoother gameplay, even during massive battles, thanks to new optimizations.

AI Improvements
🔹 Settlers Interaction Fixes
Settlers will now finish their conversations with you before returning to their homes at night or going about their business.

🔹 Settlers will follow you during dialogues if you wander off

🔹 Improved Enemy Waves AI
Enemies will be less likely to target the same spot, they will spread out more, which should create more interesting base defence scenarios.

🎥 Updated Intro Cutscene
✨ Featuring: Tru’s handsome new look.
✨ Small camera angle tweaked in second scene.
✨ Fixed visible pickups effects during the cutscene.

Audio and Visual Improvements
🎵 SFX Adjustments
Footstep sounds have been reduced: 20% quieter for running and 40% for walking (Tru and Mech).

Bug Fixes
🐛 Monster Nest Slot Bars below hp indicator now will be displayed correctly.
🐛 Resolved an issue where charged slots in monster nests didn’t spawn enemies after being hit.
🐛 Typo Corrections: Thanks to @Fulgur from our Discord for spotting a typo—fixed!
🐛The “Improvement is the Key” quest now progresses correctly during the second island transition, based on feedback on our Discord @Bravo!
🐛Gaianas (those Big floating creatures) will no longer disappear when moving slightly off-screen.


This update sets the stage for the 0.6x release, bringing new horizons to explore and fresh challenges to conquer. Until then, dive into Update #12 and please let us know how these changes enhance your adventure!

PS. (from Damian) I would like to thank all the people who have given us their feedback in our Steam Discussion tab recently! It helped to create some cool improvements (like, in my opinion), the visual effects on the monster nests with LOTR vines :) Lord THEN, Dragon, /!\Kapudd and everyone who shared their feedback, thank you! 

Happy exploring,
The First Dwarf Team

notes.title: Update #11: A New Chapter in on-line Co-op
notes.notes:
This may seem like a small update for First Dwarf, but it’s a giant leap for our online co-op mode! 🚀

With Update #11, we’re introducing a literally game-changing feature: players can now independently access their maps, character menus, and item screens without pausing the action for their co-op partner. As one player navigates menus, the other will see a floating, semi-transparent screen in front of their companion, displaying exactly what they’re doing. For example, if Tru is studying the map, Ragna will see Tru standing still with a map projection hovering at eye level, an immersive way to keep both players in sync. 🗺️✨

notes.title: Update #5 BIG: Welcome to Ruptured Canyon!
notes.notes:
Hi Adventurers! 👋

If you read the title, you already know what’s up! We are adding the 3rd island - more than double the game area compared to what was available during Early Access. But it's not just about quantity. That's why we've introduced new weapons, fearsome enemies, a brand-new clan, challenging puzzles, and much more.

The size of this island gives us many opportunities for further development. We'll be working on adding new content and we will continue to polish this new area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/2d2e70965abd867ac9af0822fe6eba955da6ffa8.gif

We’re really excited about the direction the game is heading, and it’s all thanks to you — our amazing community. Your incredible support, invaluable feedback, and relentless bug-hunting have been crucial in shaping the game. We couldn’t have done it without you!

Full Change Log (Version 0.407):

The BIGGEST changes:

 NEW island (the biggest to date) including:
 NEW Scholars Guild
 NEW Technology to unlock
 NEW buildings 

 Scholars Research Center 
 Scholars Community Hut 
 Anchor Spot
 3 NEW variants of weapons to unlock in the Technology Tree
Monster variants of animals improved and added into enemy waves and dungeons; 

new coloration added for all enemies based on their type
First iteration of the Airship 

you can enter and exit Airship in the Ports and buildable Anchor Spots
Ship can’t fly into the tainted areas marked on the map as purple clouds
New consumable items (you can see the full list on our >>Discord!<<
UI rework 

added equip tab for every character where you can assign weapons and consumables
quick access slots for consumable items
New pickups in the game world
Other Important changes:

DLSS is now available for Nvidia (joining earlier available XeSS in the menu)
Now you can set your own marker on the map
Now you can knock on the settler’s house to make them come out

Let’s go through it! 📝

New Island = New Challenges

It’s not just a new island… It is the biggest island from the three we currently have in our game. What does the mysterious fog hide?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b667d51dd38b8dc2a6209cc7e276dd8f17e51353.gif
You’ll find there new Scholars Guild and following it - new technology to unlock and new buildings, such as Research Center, Community Hut and Anchor Spots.

3 NEW weapons ⛏️

The more the better, right? Now you have three NEW weapons to unlock in your Technology Tree, which are:

 Ancestor’s Pickaxe - 50% more efficient than normal pickaxe.
 Dwarven Hammer - classic dwarven hammer, gives higher chances to stagger enemies.
 Artifact Hammer - ancient hammer, tarnished and rusty, but still noble. Very powerful.

Tainted animals added in enemy waves 🐺

Fighting monsters can be tricky, we know. That's why… We are giving you ANOTHER challenge! You're welcome! Now, Monster versions of animals join the enemy waves and will attack your colonies. Be prepared!

Now you can use consumables, by accessing your inventory and pressing “use” with a correct key or button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/2fe9477a6d3507b7d931794b27c33536a1a7665f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/02bfc027ccf4d80d51abd0d48a8f739a8d9bc9e9.png

Airship Guide

If you're having any troubles with this new feature and progressing to the 3rd island, we prepared a guide that might be helpful for you here.

notes.title: Playtest 2.0 - online co-op mode and new update
notes.notes:
Today is the day, Dwarves! 🛠

Thanks to your feedback from the 1st Playtest we decided to speed up the second round! First Dwarf Playtest 2.0 will feature fixes that players pointed out in previous tests as well as the first alfa version of our online and local co-op mode and some new things to do on the island! Make sure your Playtest is updated to 0.253 version!

PS. We tried to fix as many things as we could in the time that we had and this is not the end of the fixes!

It’s our first try with co-op in First Dwarf, so please keep in mind that it’s still a work in progress. That’s why your feedback can really help us with polishing the mechanics of multiplayer!

When? ⏰

Playtest starts TODAY and ends in two weeks on the 6th of May 7PM (CEST).

Who can participate? 🤔

Just like last time, everyone can participate! If you had access to the 1st Playtest, you don’t have to request it again. There will be an update for you to download in your game library. 

If you didn’t request access during our 1st Playtest, you can do it right now and up until 6th of May 7PM (CEST). Remember that when the clock hits the ending date, access to the game will be disabled.

What’s N E W ✨

Thanks to all your feedback that we gathered (for which we are extremely grateful!), we fixed some bugs, text errors and mechanics. Now you can charge mana and fix buildings twice as fast.  

One of the main changes that’s easy to detect is making the buildings that are disconnected from the mana pipes glow red. This way it’s easier to tell if they’re functional!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/8f8b1b5a22055f3d943e994e04b9d6d7168b09f6.gif

There is also a new puzzle for Ragna added, so you have more opportunities to use her beautiful wings!

Play with your friend! 🐉🧔‍♂️

We know that a lot of you were waiting for our online and local co-op mode! And now the first taste is finally available for you to try!

In a single-player game you can switch between characters, completing tasks with the one with better skills in a given field.

In co-op, you can share a splitscreen locally, by making one person join with a gamepad and the second one playing with a keyboard, or you can invite a friend online and play on separate devices. Tru and Ragna have separate skills to develop and upgrade, strengths and weaknesses, so it’s important to choose the characters wisely when preparing to complete specific tasks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/bb239e9bce104b0cb81a6a1f0be5ae7b91750389.png

You can change characters during the co-op gameplay, but you can’t control the same character at the same time. Mech can be controlled by both Ragna and Tru.

[previewyoutube=uKQD5H9-OSA;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uKQD5H9-OSA[/previewyoutube]

Camera shake slider

We acknowledged that many of you felt discomfort caused by the shaking of the camera. From now on, you can adjust that motion and if you wish, turn it off completely.

Please tell us your thoughts on this change! We hope that now you can enjoy the game with us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/cb085232a828f582c9efb196e73d9a65f679d544.png

📜 Change log 📜

New:

 Camera shake slider
 Pop-up tutorial added for combo and high jump
 New system of communicating unpowered building (red glow if not connected)
 First iteration of development tree:

[olist]
 mech [mana refueling speed, more stamina, faster repairing]
 Tru [faster mech repairing, automatic mine improvement, automatic sawmill improvement]
 Ragna [More stamina]
[/olist]
 New environment puzzle for Ragna 
 Side quest: Eskoim Hammer
 New behaviors for settlers depending on the time of the day (sleeping, working, resting)
 Option for turning on/off tower radius display
 Added 2 new enemies (they are a lot tougher!)
 Added translation of some missing texts in a few languages
 New sounds added (monster nests, mech swimming and more)

Changes:

 Doubled the repairing speed
 Doubled the speed of mana extraction with mech
 Mech high jump and gliding improved
 Improved clarity and hints for Workshop quest  
 The way to the second island has been made easier to traverse
 Improved Ragna scouting mechanic
 Improved Ragna’s fire breathing and aiming  (still needs some tweaking)
 Experience points for quests, destroying monster nests, destroying monsters, etc. have been balanced with the level system in the game
 Mysterious flying object “upgraded” #spooky

Fixes:

 Adjusted audio in intro cutscene
 Some language errors fixed
 Names of some objectives corrected
 Fixed bug with Raven sending and the Port
 Menu sounds tweaked
 Mortar Tower rotation bug fixed
 Tru’s stance fixed while repairing the mech, Mech’s stance fixed while retrieving mana
 and some lot of smaller fixes

Your Feedback 🖱🎮

We’re counting on your feedback! Let’s create the game together and share some ideas! We’ll be very grateful for more of your thoughts during the second round of play testing.

Here is the reminder on how to do it:

First method is:

 First Dwarf Discord server

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

You’ll find there a special Playtest category:

playtest-bugs - here you can send us all the information about encountered bugs (happens to the best of us), see pinned messages in that channel for more information, so we could have the best understanding of the problem and could fix it in the future!

feedback - that’s the place where you can tell us EVERYTHING you want after you played our game. Positive and negative feedback, all of that is welcome. You can tell us about the smallest things, regarding music, characters, dialogues, mechanics, systems… Every topic is a good topic, as long as it’s related to the First Dwarf Playtest. We can’t wait to chat with you about your experiences with our title! 

language-bugs - here you can post all language related errors. Please have in mind that the game is still in progress and so are the languages, so translations may have some mistakes. We apologize for that. They are in beta version, and will be improved with time. Texts and dialogues can also be altered later, if necessary. You can change the language in the game’s menu options!

opt-in-credits - here you can read the steps of what to do, to be included in our final game’s credits! It’s a little “thank you” from us, for all your help. By leaving your invaluable feedback, you’re becoming an important part of our big adventure! You’ll find there the link to the form we prepared earlier, where you’ll be able to drop your nickname. No offensive names of course, those won’t be included.

If you gave us your nickname in the last Playtest, you don’t have to write it again. 👍

Second method for leaving feedback:

 In the game itself, as seen below

Probably the fastest way to report a bug is located directly in the game. An automatic save file is also attached to the report you make (but you won't see it, so don't panic!). However, keep in mind that we won’t be able to respond to you there. We will receive the information, but to hear back from us or to engage in conversation, it’s best to use Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/8dc5c9fb5261fa46563efe193510f9861a50f77e.png

Third method to leave feedback:

 Steam Discussion on the game’s page

Fill the Form! 📝

We prepared a simple form to fill, which may inspire you in terms of what to be aware of while playing. After leaving your feedback, you can also write your nickname to be put in the final game’s credits there, it’s optional. If you gave us your nickname in the last Playtest, you don’t have to write it again. 👍

https://forms.gle/zkZLTsh76H6CePz37

Can I stream my game?📸

YES! Feel free to tag us and show off on our Discord server, we would love to see it! You can freely post about it on your social media. Even more! You can use our Press Kit, if you wish:

First Dwarf Press Kit

Earth Appreciation Festival

Today is Earth Day! It’s a very important date and we do what we can to remind everyone about it! Earth Appreciation Festival is a list of specially selected games that focus on a post-apocalyptic grim atmosphere of a future that we should avoid. 

But not only that! You can also find nature-focused games there, to appreciate all the good things about Earth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/6f270c1e07445b42acc402fd94f90cd1eb7fd9bc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/5a2c07be1bbc1ddb7f5fbb47eaa27bb54d0e68a5.png

Are you ready? 🏁

And that’s about it! We hope that the changes we made recently will positively influence your experience. Let us know!

❤️ Add to your wishlist ❤️

Remember that adding our games to your wishlist on Steam is a wonderful way to show your support! We’d be very grateful if you could consider adding First Dwarf to your lists, as well as our upcoming prologue, First Dwarf: First Island!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865680/First_Dwarf_Prologue__First_Island/


Thank you all for reading and for your support! We deeply care about our project and want to improve it even further! It can be possible with your help. 

Have fun play testing our newest build of First Dwarf and have a wonderful day!

Yours,
Star Drifters Team 🌟🚀

notes.title: Dev Update #14 - Choose your weapon!
notes.notes:
Hi, Dwarves! 🧔

As always, many things are happening right now in our studio! We’re here today with a showcase of weapons you can obtain in our game! So if you’re eager to take care of some dangerous monsters… This might interest you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/797c66785f4b0239dd54c6be7f0c54ed093737d9.png

Did you join our Playtest? 😎

Good ol’ Pickaxe

We’re starting off with our loyal pickaxe! Which is great in dealing with persisting bullies. It’s also very helpful in gathering precious resources, like wood and stone. A perfect two in one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/5e2a39499b4339715546aee9172d4e9064397d18.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/40b717faa714ca4eb0b57812eb0ceaa7a32e8ecd.gif

But everyone needs some changes from time to time, right? Further in the game, you can find…

Battle Axe

Well, you can’t mine with that, but it’s a fair exchange for this POWERFUL weapon! It’s best for quick combat, when you’re running short of time. Made with help of Eskoim technology.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/a61146aa67b581e06e85ca844514d4f5f3aa2ed9.gif

Hammer

If you really want to serve those monsters a 💥PUNCH💥 the hammer may be the way to go. It’s slower than other weapons, but its strength is irreplaceable. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/7c45edd3d72461be53f955f8e992f9f11f110a64.gif

Tru’s Hammer

Don’t ever think that our main hero is hopeless without his mech! Tru is a brave and strong dwarf that can take care of dangerous enemies on his own, if needed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/326d6d607c05e48b66ed212260e821ad4d9f4662.gif

Blunderbuss

Sometimes, you just want to keep your distance. And that’s fine! Here to your aid comes a blunderbuss! A firearm with a short, large caliber barrel. It’s attached to the left arm of our mech.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/653eeda3d948a85895ff9b25ead6157e5687ff9f.gif

Crossbow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c054156d45fc50a6287ecca26a58e9fca0cf70c4.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/843cbc37cb0e9625a6438051722ae7ed8a127c87.gif

Powerful Dash

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/23c7d78621892cc7016702ce0ad8b9c590b50ec3.gif

notes.title: Dev Update #13 - What’s your specialty? A little bit about guilds 🛠
notes.notes:
Hi, Dwarves! We’re slowly but surely approaching the date of our upcoming playtests of First Dwarf!

Short Recap 👇

In case you missed that: you can already sign-up on our Steam page and when your calendar sets on March 25th, we’ll be waiting for your feedback on our Discord server! You can join the Discord event, so you’ll be notified right away when the game will be available to play. 🎮

Dwarven Guilds

Hard work in our studio never stops and today we would like to walk you through a very important part of our game. We’re gonna talk about guilds!

Our dear Tru himself, is from the guild of Pioneers. They’re experienced with building and maintaining mechs. Looking at the whole picture, there is no surprise that the First Dwarf has been selected from this particular guild. Who would be a better mech pilot, than someone who creates them! 

They are the first guild to arrive on our first colonized island.

Each guild has some unique touches to it, Pioneers carry a lot of tools in case there would be a mech malfunction. Better safe than sorry. Tru’s mother is a perfect example of a dwarven woman from a Pioneer guild. Little magnifying glass and a full equipped belt. What do you think? Beard or no beard?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/5824d69ccc6db2b1e9ad6b918445db9c2975c571.png

Their image is not the only thing distinctive for the guild. Each of them has their own special buildings, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/1f6643cd62e7701acad20a9e10d02512f3c64d39.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/7e8303264bfcdf331486ac7d660ee10f17532ce8.png

Thanks to that, we can learn new things, get upgrades and skills related to their field of specialization. Pioneers can help us upgrade our mech armor. Hunters can teach us how to get more food resources and Shipsmakers can help us upgrade our flying ship. Discover new ways to make life on islands the best possible!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/49e64fd21fb14611044b5307cfdfed88589547e2.png

Of course, that’s not all of the present guilds that you will encounter on your path. There are also Scientists - they can teach us mainly about science related upgrades, Naturalists, who will help us unlock new recipes, Carpenters, Miners, Scholars, Explorers and Craftsfolks! Each guild is unique and its knowledge is irreplaceable during our adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b5c1a747b14d19cdf1e2cb9ec2ade3946e444acd.png

Also, different species will give us special items for saving them or their nests as a token of gratitude! Those items can be used for crafting special upgrades for us or our buildings.

If you have any name ideas for these new species, feel free to share them with us in the comments! And don’t try to look for these animals in any encyclopedia, trust us, we’ve been there.

This one you should know

But Hey! We’re not reinventing the wheel with the next creature. Good ol’ dragon! Ragna surely isn’t the only one of her kind, right? Are they as helpful and cool as our sweet-voiced friend, though… that's unknown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/035462dfc6209b5355b6457d040299087051a293.jpg

…Would you play it?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/87749659c4dcf998f6db859beae1151f561a4dfc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/bf6e0263c87dd34491581184b8208fb720c0732e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/08b0e498a33494aa4e7312d587ad5bf53356f980.png

The competition mentioned above helped us create some new mechanics for First Dwarf, our upcoming Action RPG set in the world of Driftland. Those mechanics evolved into a full-fledged, asymmetrical co-op mode of the game, which we implemented in its build! Thank you to the co-organizers of the competition: Ministry of Culture and National Heritage of Poland, Centrum GovTech Poland, and CRPK, as well as Copernicus Game Jam 2022 - during which the diplomas were handed over and everyone who supported us along the way.

How does our co-op mode work?

In this asymmetrical co-op 🐉 player can take control over the mech or one of its pilots: Tru or Ragna. Each of them has its own, separate skills to develop and upgrade. All characters have their strengths and weaknesses so it’s important to choose the characters wisely when preparing to complete certain tasks. 

In a single-player game, the player can switch between characters, completing tasks with the one with better skills in a given field. Tru, Ragna, and the Mech will have different skill trees. Tru will be a better Mecha pilot, Ragna can e.g. fly, and the Mech can be treated as a kind of armored vehicle, so without a pilot it will not work.
